title: Reserve Rights (RSR) Overview: Price, Market Data, and Risk
content:
Reserve Rights (RSR) is tracked by TokenRadar as a Decentralized Finance (DeFi), [Arbitrum](/arbitrum) Ecosystem, [Ethereum](/ethereum) Ecosystem, [Real](/asset) World Assets (RWA) asset. What Is Reserve Rights (RSR)? Reserve Rights (RSR) is an ERC-20 token that serves two main purposes for the Reserve protocol: overcollateralization of Reserve stablecoins (RTokens) through [staking](/learn/what-is-staking) and governing them through proposing & voting on changes to their configuration.
